---
title: R execution controls
fig-width: 5
fig-height: 4
execute:
  echo: false
  error: true
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| echo: true
#| output: true
setup_value <- 7
cat("R_HIDDEN_SETUP\n")
```

```{r}
cat("R_SETUP_VALUE", setup_value, "\n")
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
warning("R_HIDDEN_WARNING")
message("R_HIDDEN_MESSAGE")
cat("R_VISIBLE_STDOUT\n")
```

```{r}
warning("R_VISIBLE_WARNING")
```

```{r}
#| output: false
warning("R_WARNING_WITHOUT_OUTPUT")
message("R_MESSAGE_WITHOUT_OUTPUT")
cat("R_HIDDEN_RESULT\n")
```

```{r}
stop("R_VISIBLE_ERROR")
```

```{r}
cat("R_AFTER_ALLOWED_ERROR\n")
```

See @fig-r-controls.

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-controls
#| fig-cap: R controlled plot
#| fig-alt: A line rising from one to three
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3
cat("R_FIG_SIZE", par("din"), "\n")
plot(c(1, 3), type = "l")
```
